description: This source file defines the PatternFactory class which provides static methods to compile and cache Perl5 regular expression patterns using the Apache ORO regex library within the OFBiz framework. It manages pattern creation and caching for efficient regex usage.

classes.name: PatternFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and caching Perl5 regex Pattern objects to improve performance in regex matching operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createOrGetPerl5CompiledPattern
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached Perl5 regex Pattern for a given string pattern, considering case sensitivity, and handles pattern compilation exceptions.
